results.label: Rust Engine Registry drive cards match live WASM drives_tick & record live session calls
results.measured: cardH=0.751 vs liveH=1, cardP=0.011 vs liveP=0.264, calls="This game session has called it 1 times. Last call 0.0 ms.", drives_tick->registry=false
results.expected: |cardH-liveH|<0.02, |cardP-liveP|<0.05, calls>=10 (30 Hz ticks), drives_tick syncs registry

results.label: Engine card Inputs exclude unrelated planet params & Dependency tree lists each node once
results.measured: planetParamsInHunger=8/8, inProtect=8/8, duplicateTreeNodes=[reheatingx2, planetx2, hungerx2, sensesx2, dangerx2]
results.expected: 0 planet params in drive cards; 0 duplicate nodes in Dependency tree

results.label: Data Panel respects Controls .capturing (U/F2), closes on Escape, and has a close button
results.measured: enteredCapture=true, openedOnUWhileCapturing=true, closeBtns=0, stayedOpenOnEsc=true, pauseOpenedBehind=true, dataBtnOnStartMenu=true
results.expected: U/F2 ignored while .capturing; >=1 close button; Escape closes #data-panel without opening Pause behind it

results.label: WASM DRIVE_PAGE and LITTER_PAGE wire drives_reset/litter_reset and re-anchor on in-page re-landing
results.measured: driveBridgeReset=false, litterBridgeReset=false, after 707m teleport: S=0.503 (mode="Fox is in watch."), H=1->1, pupNearNewSite=true
results.expected: driveBridge calls drives_reset, litterBridge calls litter_reset, fox re-anchors near new landing (S>0.25 instead of stranded 707 m away)

results.label: Menu allows ArrowDown/Up inside <select> and handles Escape even when focus leaves .start-panel
results.expected: ArrowDown stays on <select>; Escape closes open Pause menu regardless of focused element
results.source: src/ui/menu.ts:110-118; WAI-ARIA APG Dialog & Listbox keyboard contract

results.label: settingsPanel Reset to defaults preserves rebuild notice and keeps focus inside the form
results.measured: noteBefore="Some changes rebuild the world: they apply when you resume.", noteAfter="", activeAfter=BODY, focusInsideForm=false
results.expected: non-empty rebuild note preserved after Reset; focus remains inside form (not dropped to BODY)

results.label: timeHud blocks keys/pad behind #start-menu/#data-panel; dataPanel tracks signed rewind & avoids idle 60Hz rAF
